sheet@1440x900.text:
Keyboard shortcuts

Ctrl means ⌘ on Mac · Alt means ⌥ · Esc closes.

TRANSPORT
Play / Stop
Space
Back to start
Home
Play from a point (needs a BPM)
Click the top strip of the bars ruler
Loop the selection · Loop on / off
Ctrl+L
EDIT
Undo
Ctrl+Z
Redo
Ctrl+Shift+Z
Ctrl+Y
Copy · Cut · Paste
Ctrl+C
Ctrl+X
Ctrl+V
Duplicate
Ctrl+D
Delete (the gap remains)
Delete
Backspace
Select all clips
Ctrl+A
Add a clip to the selection
Ctrl+click
Shift+click
Rename a marker or group
F2
TIME & CLIPS
Split at the playhead or the selection
Ctrl+E
Cut Time (closes the gap on all tracks)
Ctrl+Shift+X
Extend the time selection to all tracks
Ctrl+Shift+L
Nudge the selection
← / →
Previous / next marker or clip edge
Ctrl+← / Ctrl+→
Add a marker at the playhead
M
Add the selected sound at the playhead
Enter
Double-click
Move to another track, keep the time
Shift while dragging
GRID & SNAP
Snap on / off
G
Narrower / wider grid
1 / 2
Triplet grid (needs a BPM)
3
Ignore snap while dragging
Alt + drag
Envelope mode
A
ZOOM & VIEW
Zoom in / out
+ / −
Ctrl+wheel
Scroll left / right
Shift+wheel
Zoom to the selection · Previous zoom
Z
X
Fit the whole project
Double-click the overview
Double-click the ruler (no time selection)
Overview: scroll 5 s
← / → (overview focused)
Show / hide the overview
Ctrl+Alt+O
Waveform zoom (view only, the sound does not change)
Waveform Zoom menu
TRACKS & MIX
Group · Ungroup
Ctrl+G
Ctrl+Shift+G
Fold / unfold a group
U
Add another Solo
Ctrl+click S
Volume fader ±0.1 dB
↑ / ↓
Volume fader: bigger step
PageUp / PageDown
Fine adjustment while dragging
Shift + drag
Reset to the default
Double-click
LIBRARY
Jump to the results · Move in the list
↓
↑ / ↓
Add to the active track
Enter
Clear the search
Esc
Preview from a point
Click the preview waveform
Space
GENERAL
Keyboard shortcuts
?
Close a dialog
Esc
